the job.note: on the job 指从事警察工作，警察剧高频表达

examples.en: I've been on the job 12 years, never fired my weapon
We're gonna sit here all morning? Hey, writing tickets is the heart of the job
I only give it to officers wounded on the job

what the hell.note: what the hell 常见强调反问语气

examples.en: What the hell are you talking about? You've wanted to be a detective since you were a kid
What the hell just happened? That was my wife
You want to tell me what the hell is going on? We're filming stunts for our YouTube channel

get out of.note: get out of 短语动词，用法多样

examples.en: Well, I don't know why the hell you two are so determined to get out of patrol
I died NOLAN: Police! Get out of the car! I died NOLAN: Driver, step away from your vehicle! - I died
And with their partners on ice here, I bet you they are ready to get out of Dodge
